description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates performance scores across six different dataset and metric combinations for two distinct models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1), with the text labels visually emphasized by a yellow highlight. The vertical axis represents the numeric values on a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 85 with major tick marks and labels at intervals of 20 (25, 45, 65, 85), accompanied by horizontal grid lines spaced every 10 units; neither axis features an explicit overall title. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing a pair of adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend at the top right, which also contains yellow highlighting, the blue bars represent "Flan-T5-783M", while the red bars correspond to a second category whose label is visually obscured. Every bar is annotated with its exact value in white text near the top. For the blue "Flan-T5-783M" bars, the values are 77.3 for TriviaQA (EM), 37.0 for HotPotQA (EM), 44.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 82.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 49.7 for HotPotQA (F1), and 53.3 for 2Wiki (F1). For the red bars, the values are 77.1 for TriviaQA (EM), 31.9 for HotPotQA (EM), 32.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 83.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 43.3 for HotPotQA (F1), and 38.1 for 2Wiki (F1). The shortest bar in the chart is the red bar in the HotPotQA (EM) category with a value of 31.9, while the tallest is the red bar in the TriviaQA (F1) category at 83.8. The categories are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending numerical order.
